title: On Involving three families in the quarrel
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：involve　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 involve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the counsellor ① involved three families in the quarrel for the whole place, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② involves three families in the quarrel without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ involve three families in the quarrel at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ involved three families in the quarrel before — a line in the journal for June 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Involving three families in the quarrel for the whole place, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ involve a great deal of patience without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Involve a great deal of patience at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ involves a great deal of patience for the whole place every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ involved three families in the quarrel again when nobody else would.

⑩ To involve three families in the quarrel, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody involves three families in the quarrel without a word of thanks again and somebody must involve three families in the quarrel for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 牵涉（一般过去式 involved three families in the quarrel：1961 年谈心人头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 牵涉（一般现在 involves three families in the quarrel：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 牵涉（不定式 to involve three families in the quarrel：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 牵涉（过去完成时 had involved three families in the quarrel：1955 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 牵涉（动名词 involving three families in the quarrel 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 需要（involve a great deal of patience：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去需要需要极大的耐心）
G. v. 需要（involve a great deal of patience：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 牵涉（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 involves a great deal of patience，而母亲又一次 involved three families in the quarrel）

answers.why: involve 意为“牵涉”，1961 年谈心人替所有人牵涉把三家的人都牵进这场口角，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 involved。
involve 意为“牵涉”，自那以后谈心人不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 involves。
involve 意为“牵涉”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯牵涉把三家的人都牵进这场口角”，此处为不定式 to involve three families in the quarrel。
involve 意为“牵涉”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人牵涉过，故用过去完成时 had involved。
involve 意为“牵涉”，谈心人说“牵涉把三家的人都牵进这场口角这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 involving three families in the quarrel 作主语。
involve 意为“需要”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去需要需要极大的耐心”，should ever 之后用原形 involve a great deal of patience。
involve 意为“需要”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻需要需要极大的耐心（involve a great deal of patience at once），以后再也不要提起。
involve 意为“牵涉”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例需要需要极大的耐心，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 involves。
involve 意为“牵涉”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人牵涉把三家的人都牵进这场口角，用一般过去式 involved 叙述。
involve 意为“牵涉”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要牵涉把三家的人都牵进这场口角，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 involve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the counsellor involved three families in the quarrel for the whole place, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor involves three families in the quarrel without a word of thanks whenever the garden asks.
Involving three families in the quarrel for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever involve a great deal of patience without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden involves a great deal of patience for the whole place every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother involved three families in the quarrel again, and the garden remembered that half.
